| description = Second to last turn in for the necro epic. The spawn is triggered by handing 10g to the Thunder Spirit Princess on Island 1, which will cause her to despawn and prevent anyone on that island from getting keys via Sirran turn ins (have to buy them); he will spawn in the building on Island 3. 

Unlike Inte Akera for the paladin epic, Gkzzallk does not appear to despawn until you turn in the [[Tome of Instruction]], or he is killed. I noticed someone spawned him yesterday around 1pm PST and he's still up as of 7am the following day. While this means you don't have to rush to trigger the spawn and get to island 3 in five minutes like paladins, be mindful of other guilds who might be heading up to Sky that night and don't despawn Princess during someone else's time slot.
